statement: For every connected simple graph H on exactly twelve vertices with distinct ordered terminals s,t, if deg_H(s)=deg_H(t)=2, every other vertex has degree 3, and dist_H(s,t)>=3, then H contains a simple cycle of length four or a simple cycle of length eight.
contribution: A full finite proof of the frozen claim: the exact add/delete-edge bijection reduces the domain to eligible edge deletions in Meringer's complete census of 85 connected cubic graphs on twelve vertices, and a 1,110-record certificate supplies the lexicographically least C4 or C8 in every eligible deletion. A separately written verifier authenticates the census, reconstructs complete pair coverage, validates every witness, and recomputes lexicographic minimality via edge-subset enumeration. This is a resolution claim, not a claim of publication priority; census exhaustion is an explicit cited external dependency.
